messages:
Maya: starting obs-stack ingest warmup in ap-south1 — logs/metrics/traces. kicking off promtail & otel-collector canaries. tagging: @rohit @sre-oncall
Rohit: On it. Quick checklist before we fully flip traffic: VPC endpoints, firewall rules for OTLP 4317, Prometheus scrape 9100/9600, and beats 5044 all open? Any NACL issues?
Kevin: I opened the security-group rules yesterday but didn't touch NACLs. Also reminder: MTU on the new GPU nodes is 9000 which sometimes causes drops on the NLB path. If you see TLS handshakes failing, check path MTU.
Maya: noted re MTU. For now we'll run ingest at 10% traffic, watch for packet drops and collector restarts. Starting canary commands now.
deploy-bot: Deployment kicked: observability-stack v1.5.3 -> cluster ap-south1-gpu. Canary scale: promtail=2, otel-collector=1, prometheus=1. Logs: https://ci.redwood/dep/obs/1829998888
Tara: Run these quick probes and paste outputs: `kubectl -n observability get pods -o wide` and `kubectl -n observability logs <pod>` for promtail and collector. Also run `curl -sS http://otel-collector.observability.svc:13133/health`
Maya: results — pod list and health check
```
kubectl -n observability get pods -o wide
NAME                                   READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   IP           NODE
promtail-6f8c4d7b-xy12                 2/2     Running   0          2m   10.2.4.12    gpu-node-3
otel-collector-7b9cd6f8-jk23           1/1     Running   0          3m   10.2.4.13    gpu-node-3
prometheus-server-0                    1/1     Running   0          5m   10.2.4.14    gpu-node-1
```
`curl` health: `200 OK` from otel-collector, `promtail` logs show `pushed 120 events`
Rohit: Good. Network counters? `sudo ethtool -S eth0 | grep dropped` on gpu-node-3?
Maya: ran counters, negligible drops — looks fine. Next: validate traces end-to-end. I sent a test trace from a sample service to OTLP endpoint. Check traces in Jaeger/Grafana Tempo dashboard.
Kevin: Saw the trace arrive but sampled rate looks low. Otel-collector config currently has `sampler` `probability: 0.1` by default. For canary increase to 0.5 for 30m to validate span sizes and latency.
Maya: done — bumped to 0.5 via `kubectl apply -f` to the collector config.
Rohit: Alerting templates we should enable right away (suggested):
- obs_ingest_lag_seconds: triggers if tailing lag > 300s for >5m
- promtail_restart_rate: if promtail restarts > 2 in 10m
- otel_receiver_restart_count: if collector restarts > 1 in 5m
- obs_disk_pressure_gpu_nodes: disk usage > 85% on /var/log for 10m
Add also a prometheus rule for `scrape_target_down{job=~\"prometheus.*\"}` to avoid blind spots.
Tara: I'll import a minimal grafana folder with dashboards: Logs overview, Ingest pipeline latency, Collector health. Sharing JSON import link: https://dashboards.redwood/g/obs/minimal-canary
Maya: FYI added a temporary routing policy: all non-prod traces routed to cheap-models bucket; prod traces to main. Will revert when canary ends.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: promtail throughput stable, otel-collector CPU 35%, memory 42%. Canary timer: 27m left.
Sre-oncall: Quick note — if we see `connection reset by peer` from promtail, check NLB idle timeout (defaults 350s) + keepalive. Keep keepalive enabled on promtail to avoid collector connections resetting.
Maya: copy. Final pre-handoff tasks for infra -> ops:
- confirm NACLs identical across all subnets (rohit)
- push alert templates to prometheus-rules (tara)
- export dashboards to ops dashboard folder and grant read to oncall (tara)
- run a 30m high-traffic soak at 30% for observability ingest (maya)
Rohit: I'll do the NACL sweep and ping once done.
Tara: pushing alerts and dashboards now :thumbsup:
Maya: handing off to @sre-oncall for monitoring during the soak. Thanks all.
Sre-oncall: ack — watching alerts and logs, will escalate to eng-infra if we see >0.1% dropped traces or collector restarts. Keep this thread for notes.
